# flashtex's tests and examples, vendored as an external corpus.

# source:   https://github.com/flash-tex/flashtex

# fetched:  2026-09-27, `git clone --depth 1`, read-only, its remote removed at once

# checked:  every file taken is listed in SHA256SUMS with the sha256 of its upstream
#           bytes; `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` run from this directory verifies them
#
# Taken, at their upstream paths below this directory: the document sources of six
# of flashtex's test sets, each with the inputs its directory holds (two sections
# directories and one image), and the READMEs of the three fixture sets, which say
# what each document exercises.
#
#   set                 upstream directory                                documents
#   real-world          fixtures/real-world                               26
#   divergence-probes   fixtures/divergence-probes                        52
#   proof-corpus        fixtures/proof-corpus                             10
#   amsmath-corpus      crates/compiler/tests/amsmath_corpus/fixtures     59
#   amssymb-corpus      crates/compiler/tests/amssymb_corpus/fixtures     39
#   tikz                crates/render-pipeline/fixtures/tikz              30
#
# flashtex's own expectations for these sets, which are not taken: the first three
# are its parity "fixtures" tier, each document held at a level L0-L4 against a
# committed pdfLaTeX reference.pdf (tools/parity, baseline-fixtures.json); the
# amsmath and amssymb corpora pin pdfLaTeX word positions to 0.5 bp (oracle.py);
# the TikZ probes are read by a cargo test against pdfLaTeX-derived positions.
#
# Selected: the entry documents of those sets that lualatex (LuaHBTeX 1.24.0,
# TeX Live 2026) builds under -halt-on-error, twice, in a copy of the document's
# own directory, so every document here is inside the denominator. 216 of 220.
# Left out:
#   fixtures/divergence-probes/min6-dimens-primitives   lualatex exits 1
#   fixtures/real-world/hw1, hw2, inline-math           a user's own document, by
#                                                       flashtex's README; this tree's
#                                                       fixtures are invented
# Not taken: flashtex's pdfLaTeX reference PDFs and their JSON sidecars (another
# engine's output; this corpus's reference is lualatex, rebuilt by the report), the
# fonts flashtex bundles (GUST Font License), and every other test set — among them
# the tabular corpus, the render-pipeline oracle suites (footnotes, floats, toc,
# siunitx, multicol, ...) and the unicode-tex fixtures, which name host fonts.
# scripts/external.lean --report <work> <list> builds any of them from a clone.
